newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, indicated steady, NYMEX flat.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, indicated steady, NYMEX flat.

text.p: August Brent crude futures were untraded at midday on Tuesday but prices were indicated steady in quiet Asian trading.

August Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.50/$18.55 per barrel, around the London close of $18.51. The contract gained 33 cents in London after Iraq targeted resumed oil exports for August instead of July.
Brokers said there was little talk or direction in Asia.
NYMEX crudes were hardly traded on ACCESS. August was last traded at $19.81, up one cent from New York, where the contract had gained 34 cents.
